literal_meaning: হৈ হৈ শব্দ করে চলা (walking while making 'hai hai' sounds, possibly indicating noise or exclamation)
figurative_meaning_en: making excessive cutting or sarcastic remarks
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় হৈ হৈ করে চলে, কারো কথায় কাটতি দেয়।
পার্টিতে সবাইকে হৈ হৈ করে চলা দিয়ে মজা নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He always goes around making cutting remarks about everyone.
She entertained the party by throwing sarcastic jabs at others.
note: The idiom likely originates from rural Bengali verbal banter traditions, emphasizing sharp-tongued exchanges.
